title: Baron’s fifth–sixth: non-exclusion is from mercy; comparative lightness explains why some are venial
source_text: XXXVII. Postea vero quintam & sextam assertionem his verbis enunciat, Quod hujusmodi regenitorum peccata eos non excludant a favore Dei, & a spe regni coelestis, id simpliciter & absolute habent, non ex natura sua, sed ex Dei misericordia. Si vero peccata regenitorum leviora comparative considerentur, (hoc est, si conferantur cum eorundem peccatis gravioribus,) sique quaeratur cur illa potius quam haec sint venialia, & a favore Dei non excludant? dicendum est ea ex se & sua natura hoc habere. Etsi enim, inquit, absolute loquendo, haec peccata sunt gravia, comparative tamen levia sunt: & haec comparativa eorum levitas, quae in ipsorum natura est fundata, procul-dubio est ratio, ob quam Deus voluit ea sub foedere gratiae clementius punire, quam atrocia & conscientiam vastantia peccata.
pass_a_gloss: Afterwards indeed he enunciates the fifth and sixth assertion in these words: That sins of the regenerate of this sort do not exclude them from God’s favor and from the hope of the heavenly kingdom, they have simply and absolutely not from their own nature but from God’s mercy. But if the lighter sins of the regenerate be considered comparatively (that is, if they be compared with their heavier sins), and if it be asked why those rather than these are venial and do not exclude from God’s favor, it must be said that they have this from themselves and their own nature. For although, he says, speaking absolutely these sins are grave, yet comparatively they are light: and this comparative lightness of theirs, which is founded in their own nature, is without doubt the reason why God willed to punish them more mildly under the covenant of grace than atrocious and conscience-wasting sins.
pass_b_english: Absolutely, non-exclusion from favor is mercy, not the sin’s nature.
Comparatively, lighter regenerate faults are lighter in themselves—so grace’s covenant punishes them more mildly than conscience-wasting atrocities.

choices.why: Keeps desert and covenant mildness from collapsing.
